hints.title: What is the correct order?
hints.content: The correct order is: (1) Get hardware from hardwareMap, (2) call waitForStart(), (3) set motor power. Hardware initialization must always come before waitForStart().

hints.title: Where should hardwareMap.get() go?
hints.content: Move the `DcMotor driveMotor = hardwareMap.get(DcMotor.class, "driveMotor");` line to BEFORE `waitForStart()`. A good place is right at the top of runOpMode().

hints.title: Where should setPower() go?
hints.content: The `driveMotor.setPower(1.0);` call should remain AFTER `waitForStart()`. You want to control hardware only after the match starts.

hints.title: The full solution pattern
hints.content: Rearrange so it reads: get motor -> telemetry init -> waitForStart() -> setPower -> telemetry running. This is the standard FTC OpMode pattern.
